name: Securities Settlement Transaction Query Response V 01
definition: The SecuritiesSettlementResponse message is sent from a settlement infrastructure to an account owner/requestor to provide the details of the securities settlement instructions, as selected in the search criteria defined in the request.

ReportGeneralDetails.name: Report General Details
ReportGeneralDetails.definition: General characteristics related to the report information.

ActivityIndicatorYesRule.definition: If ActivityIndicator is equal to Yes (true or 1) then Transactions must be present.

ActivityIndicatorNoRule.definition: If ActivityIndicator is equal to No (false or 0) then Transactions must be absent.

QueryTypeAndStatusReasonRule.definition: If QueryType is equal to Status (STTS) or StatusPeriod (STPD) then Transactions(*)/StatusReaon must be present.
